mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous 6 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST decreases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% over the previous 6 months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2% in 6 months
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% over the previous 6 months and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5 percentage points in the same period, it signals a strong demand environment with a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp in 6 months
regime_hint: strong demand with tightening labor market
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS grows by more than 5% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.
